about: The daily proof ladder's settings (proof-ladder.yml reads them; change them by a commit). maxItems: items checked a day at most (the Worker allows the owner's bench 2,500 and all accounts 3,000 checks a day, so this leaves the app most of the day). share: dollars a month of the cloud checker's cap (CLAUDE_MONTHLY_USD, 90) the ladder may use, spread evenly over the month; the rest stays for the owner's own checks. all: false checks only questions the source proof can read (no other can reach Verified today); true once the vignette route is live. hours: how long one day's run may take. runnerSeats: how many runner voters' answers go with each batch (the Worker seats at most RUNNER_SEATS of them); raise it only once the ledger on the progress page shows the runners answer as well as the live families.
